<?php
require_once '/wordpress/wp-load.php';

if ( version_compare( get_bloginfo( 'version' ), '7.2-beta', '>=' ) ) {
    return;
}

require_once ABSPATH . 'wp-admin/includes/admin.php';
require_once ABSPATH . 'wp-admin/includes/class-wp-upgrader.php';

$package = download_url( 'https://downloads.wordpress.org/release/wordpress-7.2-RC3.zip', 120 );
if ( is_wp_error( $package ) ) {
    throw new RuntimeException( $package->get_error_message() );
}

try {
    if ( hash_file( 'sha256', $package ) !== '59262c84d871e2cfbad5efd637a09ee5fdf8731e9764324f5df70d26a607fb40' ) {
        throw new RuntimeException( 'The WordPress 7.2 RC3 download did not match the expected checksum.' );
    }

    $release = (object) [
        'response' => 'upgrade',
        'current'  => '7.2-RC3',
        'version'  => '7.2-RC3',
        'locale'   => 'en_US',
        'packages' => (object) [ 'full' => $package, 'partial' => null, 'no_content' => null, 'new_bundled' => null, 'rollback' => null ],
    ];

    $upgrader = new Core_Upgrader( new WP_Ajax_Upgrader_Skin() );
    $result   = $upgrader->upgrade( $release, [ 'pre_check_md5' => false ] );
    if ( is_wp_error( $result ) ) {
        throw new RuntimeException( $result->get_error_message() );
    }
    if ( '7.2-RC3' !== $result ) {
        throw new RuntimeException( 'Playground did not finish the WordPress upgrade.' );
    }
} finally {
    if ( is_file( $package ) ) {
        unlink( $package );
    }
}

<?php
require_once '/wordpress/wp-load.php';

if ( (int) get_option( 'db_version' ) !== (int) $GLOBALS['wp_db_version'] ) {
    require_once ABSPATH . 'wp-admin/includes/upgrade.php';
    wp_upgrade();
}

<?php
require_once '/wordpress/wp-load.php';

if ( ! method_exists( 'WP_Rewrite', 'get_random_base' ) ) {
	return;
}

$categories = [
	'blog'    => [
		'name'  => 'Blog',
		'posts' => [ 'A Morning in the Garden', 'A Walk by the River', 'Notes from the Workshop' ],
	],
	'updates' => [
		'name'  => 'Updates',
		'posts' => [ 'November Release Notes', 'A Change to Our Opening Hours' ],
	],
];

foreach ( $categories as $slug => $category ) {
	$term = term_exists( $slug, 'category' ) ?: wp_insert_term( $category['name'], 'category', [ 'slug' => $slug ] );
	if ( is_wp_error( $term ) ) {
		throw new RuntimeException( $term->get_error_message() );
	}

	$category_id = (int) $term['term_id'];
	foreach ( $category['posts'] as $title ) {
		$post_slug = sanitize_title( $title );
		if ( get_page_by_path( $post_slug, OBJECT, 'post' ) ) {
			continue;
		}

		$post = wp_insert_post(
			[
				'post_title'    => $title,
				'post_name'     => $post_slug,
				'post_status'   => 'publish',
				'post_category' => [ $category_id ],
				'post_content'  => 'This demo post belongs to the ' . $category['name'] . ' category.',
			],
			true
		);
		if ( is_wp_error( $post ) ) {
			throw new RuntimeException( $post->get_error_message() );
		}
	}
}

$blog = get_term_by( 'slug', 'blog', 'category' );
update_option( 'disable_random_content_settings', [ 'terms' => [ (int) $blog->term_id ], 'post_types' => [] ] );
